snippet.title: Attack on Inirea - 60s Gameplay Trailer 3
snippet.description:
In this arcade-style shooter, you will take command of powerful weapons to defend the village of Inirea from hordes of monsters, gaining points and powerups as you progress through the game.

Attack on Inirea, available on PC, Mac, Linux, Steam Deck.

Steam page: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3633790/Attack_on_Inirea/

Website:
https://www.seamentertainment.com
